title: Comprehensive Income and Other Comprehensive Income (OCI)

definitions.comprehensive_income: Change in equity during period from transactions and events from NON-OWNER sources. Includes all changes in equity except investments by owners and distributions to owners.
definitions.net_income: Traditional bottom line on income statement
definitions.other_comprehensive_income: Revenues, expenses, gains, and losses that are included in comprehensive income but EXCLUDED from net income
definitions.formula: Comprehensive Income = Net Income + Other Comprehensive Income (OCI)

components_of_oci.mnemonic: PUFF - Pension, Unrealized, Foreign, Fair value

1_unrealized_gains_losses_afs.description: Unrealized gains/losses on available-for-sale (AFS) debt securities
1_unrealized_gains_losses_afs.when_reclassified_to_NI: When AFS security is sold (reclassification adjustment)
1_unrealized_gains_losses_afs.example: AFS bond increases in value $10K → DR Investment $10K, CR OCI $10K. When sold: CR OCI $10K, DR Gain (NI) $10K

2_foreign_currency_translation.description: Foreign currency translation adjustments from translating foreign subsidiary's statements
2_foreign_currency_translation.when_reclassified_to_NI: When foreign subsidiary is sold or substantially liquidated
2_foreign_currency_translation.note: Not same as foreign currency transaction gains/losses (those go to NI immediately)

3_pension_adjustments.description: Prior service cost and actuarial gains/losses not yet recognized in pension expense
3_pension_adjustments.when_reclassified_to_NI: Amortized to pension expense over time using corridor method
components: Prior service cost from plan amendments

4_cash_flow_hedges.description: Effective portion of unrealized gains/losses on cash flow hedges (derivatives hedging forecasted transactions)
4_cash_flow_hedges.when_reclassified_to_NI: When hedged forecasted transaction affects earnings
4_cash_flow_hedges.note: Fair value hedge gains/losses go directly to NI (not OCI)

NOT_in_oci: Unrealized gains/losses on trading securities (go to NI)
Foreign currency transaction gains/losses (go to NI)
Ineffective portion of hedges (goes to NI immediately)

option_1_single_statement.description: Single continuous statement of comprehensive income
option_1_single_statement.format: Start with revenues → Net income → OCI items → Comprehensive income

option_2_two_statements.description: Separate income statement and statement of comprehensive income
option_2_two_statements.format: Income statement ends at Net Income. Separate statement starts with Net Income → add OCI items → Comprehensive income

presentation_options.location_on_balance_sheet: Accumulated OCI (AOCI) reported in stockholders' equity section

accumulated_oci.definition: Cumulative amount of OCI items (similar to retained earnings for net income)
accumulated_oci.balance_sheet_presentation: Stockholders' Equity section shows: Common stock, Additional paid-in capital, Retained earnings, Accumulated OCI, Treasury stock
accumulated_oci.formula: Ending AOCI = Beginning AOCI + Current year OCI

reclassification_adjustments.purpose: Prevent double-counting when OCI item is realized and moved to net income
example_afs_sale: Year 2: Bond FV increases to $110K → DR Investment $10K, CR OCI $10K (not in NI)
Year 3: Bond sold for $110K → Realized gain $10K goes to NI. Must reclassify OCI: DR OCI $10K, CR Reclassification adjustment (reduces OCI) $10K
Result: Year 3 comprehensive income shows: NI includes $10K gain, OCI shows ($10K) reclassification, net effect $0 (prevents double-counting)
reclassification_adjustments.disclosure: Reclassification adjustments disclosed on face of statement or in notes

calculation_example.facts: Year 3 data: Net income $500K. Unrealized gain on AFS securities $20K. Foreign currency translation loss $8K. Pension prior service cost amortization $5K. Beginning AOCI $30K.

oci_calculation.pension_amortization: -$5K (reduces OCI, increases pension expense in NI)

tax_effects.oci_items_taxable: OCI items generally have deferred tax effects
tax_effects.net_or_gross: May present OCI items net of tax or gross with separate tax line
tax_effects.example: Unrealized AFS gain $10K pretax, tax rate 30% → OCI net of tax = $7K, or show OCI $10K with deferred tax expense $3K

cpa_exam_tips: PUFF mnemonic: Pension adjustments, Unrealized AFS gains/losses, Foreign currency translation, Fair value hedges (cash flow hedges)
Trading securities NOT in OCI (unrealized gains/losses go to NI immediately)
Fair value hedges NOT in OCI (go to NI). Cash flow hedges go to OCI.
Reclassification adjustment prevents double-counting when OCI realized
AOCI is cumulative (like retained earnings) reported in equity

identification.in_oci: AFS unrealized gains/losses, foreign currency TRANSLATION, pension prior service cost and actuarial gains/losses, CASH FLOW hedge effective portion
identification.in_net_income_not_oci: Trading securities unrealized, foreign currency TRANSACTION, FAIR VALUE hedge gains/losses, ineffective hedge portions

calculation_approach: 4. For AOCI: Beginning AOCI + Current period OCI = Ending AOCI
common_mistakes: Including trading securities unrealized gains/losses in OCI (they go to NI)
Confusing foreign currency translation (OCI) with transaction (NI)
Confusing fair value hedges (NI) with cash flow hedges (OCI)
Forgetting reclassification adjustment when OCI item realized

key_points: Comprehensive Income = Net Income + Other Comprehensive Income (OCI)
OCI components: PUFF (Pension, Unrealized AFS, Foreign translation, Fair value/cash flow hedges)
Trading securities NOT in OCI (go to NI)
AOCI is cumulative balance in stockholders' equity
Reclassification adjustments prevent double-counting when OCI realized
Two presentation options: single statement or two separate statements
